prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone equipment attachment inventory icon for TidalLine, a fictional 1990s post-flood salvage game. Authentic chunky low-resolution pixel art, readable square pixel clusters, simplified realistic metal and polymer, restrained muted industrial colors, upper-left light and clear lighter edges on dark green UI. Consistent slightly elevated three-quarter product display, entire single object visible, centered within 40x40 logical pixels on 48x48 canvas with at least 4 logical pixels transparent padding. Genuinely transparent background, no ground, shadow, scene, firearm, hands, person, UI, rarity background, text, logos, letters, numbers, glow, watermark, photorealism or futuristic elements. Object ONLY: precision buttstock, heavy graphite body, raised cheek rest, adjustable flat shoulder pad with two small silver adjustment knobs, restrained 1990s industrial design.
